title: Cosine at an Axis Angle
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Determine $\cos\left(\dfrac{3\pi}{2}\right)$ exactly by locating the terminal side of the angle on the unit circle.

steps.title: Locate the Terminal Side
steps.explanation: Three quarter-turns place the terminal side straight down along the negative $y$-axis.
steps.why: Axis angles land on coordinate axes, where one coordinate vanishes.

steps.title: Read the Unit-Circle Point
steps.explanation: The intersection of that ray with the unit circle is the point $(0,-1)$.
steps.why: Every angle's trig values come from its unit-circle point.

steps.title: Extract the Cosine
steps.explanation: Cosine is the $x$-coordinate of the point, which is $0$ here.
steps.why: Points on the $y$-axis have zero horizontal coordinate by definition.
